About this item

  • 【2026 Updated Pull-Up Machine】Perform seated leg raises, pull-ups, dips, inverted rows and push-ups on one versatile station—bringing more upper-body and core training options into your home gym.
  • 【100% Core Focus. Smarter Training.】The seated leg raise position supports your body from below, so your arms only help maintain balance instead of bearing your full body weight—letting you focus on controlled core contractions.
  • 【Multi-Grip Sculpted Back Definition】Switch between wide, overhand and neutral grips to vary muscle emphasis, improve pulling control and train your back from multiple angles.
  • 【Unique Loadable Core Training Station】Add weight plates or resistance bands to gradually increase the challenge, supporting progressive core training as your strength improves.
  • 【Rock Solid Base Performance】A 104.5 lb steel frame, widened Π-shaped base and 4 non-slip feet keep the tower firmly planted through pull-ups, dips and leg raises—rated up to 800 lb.
  • 【Adjusts to Fit Your Body & Training】Choose from 9 height settings, 4 dip-handle positions and 12 foot-bar positions to create a more natural setup for users up to 6'6".
  • 【Comfort Where Your Body Needs It Most】A wide contoured backrest and thick arm pads cushion key pressure points, while textured foot plates provide secure support throughout your workout.
  • 【Ships in 2 Boxes | 5-Year Warranty】Your power tower arrives in two separate boxes, which may be delivered at different times. The complete unit is backed by a 5-year warranty for long-term peace of mind.

      Super sturdy - I would have given a five except for:

      1) the pull up bar is “crowded” - you can’t use the whole width of it and you are limited to three hand positions.

      2) the dip handles are very small in diameter. I can fix that by adding bigger grips and I’m going to do that - but I shouldn’t have to.

      I’m very satisfied - and I can fix the dip handle issue - but still a little disappointed in the crowded pull-up area.

    About this Item

    • 【2026 Updated Pull-Up Machine】Perform seated leg raises, pull-ups, dips, inverted rows and push-ups on one versatile station—bringing more upper-body and core training options into your home gym.
    • 【100% Core Focus. Smarter Training.】The seated leg raise position supports your body from below, so your arms only help maintain balance instead of bearing your full body weight—letting you focus on controlled core contractions.
    • 【Multi-Grip Sculpted Back Definition】Switch between wide, overhand and neutral grips to vary muscle emphasis, improve pulling control and train your back from multiple angles.
    • 【Unique Loadable Core Training Station】Add weight plates or resistance bands to gradually increase the challenge, supporting progressive core training as your strength improves.
    • 【Rock Solid Base Performance】A 104.5 lb steel frame, widened Π-shaped base and 4 non-slip feet keep the tower firmly planted through pull-ups, dips and leg raises—rated up to 800 lb.
    • 【Adjusts to Fit Your Body & Training】Choose from 9 height settings, 4 dip-handle positions and 12 foot-bar positions to create a more natural setup for users up to 6'6".
    • 【Comfort Where Your Body Needs It Most】A wide contoured backrest and thick arm pads cushion key pressure points, while textured foot plates provide secure support throughout your workout.
    • 【Ships in 2 Boxes | 5-Year Warranty】Your power tower arrives in two separate boxes, which may be delivered at different times. The complete unit is backed by a 5-year warranty for long-term peace of mind.
